issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other (Water Fund 24,665.53; Sewer Fund 15,326.63)
issues.issue: Applies to receipts[8] and receipts[9]. These Water and Sewer fund receipts are printed only as 'Local Receipts: Other'. The extractor assumed they are utility sales. If so, the user's 2026-10-28 rule makes the category Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees. If not, the lines are unexplained 'Other'. Either way the category is an assumption (already marked review).
